title: Lemma 12.11: connectivity and coherence of the tensor product of a connective coherent module
statement_scope: Let f:(X',O_{X'})->(X,O_X) be a map of derived complex analytic spaces, where X=Shv(X) and X'=Shv(X') so that the pairs (X, pi_0 O_X^alg) and (X', pi_0 O_{X'}^alg) are complex analytic spaces. Suppose that F is a connective sheaf of O_X^alg-modules on X, and that each pi_k F is a coherent sheaf of pi_0 O_X^alg-modules. Then the tensor product F' = f^*F tensor_{f^*O_X^alg} O_{X'}^alg is connective, and each pi_k F' is a coherent sheaf of pi_0 O_{X'}^alg-modules. The whole lemma is retained, with no subpart split off.
